_description: Quatro brand palette tokens v2 (May 2026 refinement). Paired with DataOS palette in the upstream technical-diagrams skill. Every Quatro diagram declares @brand: quatro at the top of its source file and renders with these tokens. Eco-track diagrams use the warm palette (paper, ink, bone, taupe). Defense and technical diagrams use the slate palette. See QUATRO-PALETTE-V2-PROPOSAL.md for full rationale.

quatro._spine: Forest and charcoal are the spine of every Quatro surface.
quatro._warm_spine: Eco-track surfaces use warm paper and ink instead of cool slate. Inspired by Whole Earth Catalog, McLuhan Understanding Media, Global Interior LATAM.
quatro._accents: Ochre is the canonical eco-track second color. Indigo-ink is the editorial second accent. Terracotta is warnings only.
quatro._defense_scope: Slate-marine and horizon-tan are scoped to defense, federal capture, SATCOM hardware photography, and the homepage hero gradient. Never on eco-track surfaces.
quatro._technical_surfaces: Cool slate scale stays unchanged for dashboards, ops UI, schematic mode. Lives separately from the warm scale.

usage_rules.single_emphasis: Only one element per diagram gets forest fill. Two emphases equals emphasis lost.
usage_rules.ochre_scope: Ochre appears only on eco-track diagrams. Never on defense, federal capture, SATCOM, or any DataOS crossover.
usage_rules.warm_vs_slate: Eco-track diagrams use paper (#F2EBDA) background and ink (#16161E) text. Defense and technical diagrams use slate50 (#F9FAFB) and slate900 (#020617).
usage_rules.slate_marine_scope: Slate-marine (#4D6870) is only for hardware/product photography backdrops on defense surfaces. Never as a diagram background.
usage_rules.horizon_tan_scope: Horizon-tan (#9A8A7A) is a gradient stop only. Never as a solid fill or diagram color.
usage_rules.brand_declaration: Every Quatro diagram source file must open with // @brand: quatro
usage_rules.font_stack: Roobert for headers, JetBrains Mono for labels at 10px. Reckless is not used in diagrams.
